mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 0.5% signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 9.5% in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger equity sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of months when UNRATE exceeds 9.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.01 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous contraction in real GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a broad-based economic slowdown that triggers equity market declines, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The negative return signal fails when either GDPC1 or HOUST is not declining, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100), the supply shock to the economy causes a temporary equity market correction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC for the INDPRO signal is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above its 12-month moving average signals strong consumer demand that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS is above its 12-month MA, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten policy, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.01.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of declining non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS < 0.5% YoY), the labor market weakness reduces consumer spending confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS YoY growth < 0.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) declines below 100 and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 0.5%, the combination of supply shock and accommodative policy fails to prevent equity market declines, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The negative return signal fails when either INDPRO >= 100 or FEDFUNDS >= 0.5, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02.
